_readme: This drives the activity selector on services.html.
key      — must match the folder name under site/images/gallery/
name     — shown in the list and as the big heading
tagline  — one short line, always smaller than the name
slot     — a CSS image variable from dotfit.css (search IMAGE SLOTS)
body     — one or two sentences. Plain, true, no claims you cannot back.
benefits — three or four short lines
related  — links to pages that already exist on this site
The copy below is a starting point written from the activity itself.
Replace it with how Dotfit actually runs each one — that is the part

activities.name: Yoga
activities.body: Guided sessions working through breath, mobility and controlled strength. Useful on its own, and useful as the thing that keeps heavier training sustainable.
benefits: Range of motion through hips, shoulders and spine
Breathing and recovery between hard sessions

activities.name: Zumba
activities.body: A dance workout set to music, where the cardio happens because you are enjoying yourself rather than counting reps. No dance background needed.
benefits: Cardio without it feeling like cardio
One of the easiest classes to start with

activities.name: CrossFit
activities.body: Functional movement, strength and conditioning run at an intensity that keeps progress honest. Sessions are coached and every movement has a scaled version.
benefits: Strength and conditioning in the same session

activities.name: HIIT
activities.tagline: Short intervals. Hard effort. Real conditioning.
activities.body: High-intensity intervals with short rests. The shortest useful session in the building, which is exactly why it works around a full working day.

activities.name: Cycling
activities.tagline: Ride hard indoors, go further outdoors
activities.body: Indoor cycling sessions built around intervals and endurance blocks, with low impact on the knees and ankles.

activities.name: Aerobics
activities.body: Choreographed cardio at a pace you can hold. A straightforward way back into training if it has been a while.
benefits: Easy to keep up week to week

activities.name: Personal Training
activities.tagline: One trainer, one plan, one goal
activities.body: A programme built around where you are starting from, with a trainer watching every set. The fastest way to fix form before it becomes a habit.

activities.name: Weight Training
activities.tagline: Load the bar. Build the base.
activities.body: Free weights and machine work programmed for strength, hypertrophy or body recomposition, with progressive overload tracked rather than guessed.
